population_profile.notes: Heavy South Asian and East Asian representation. Students prefer protein-forward meals. Unfamiliar preparations consistently waste >40%.

key_insights: Cauliflower in any preparation wastes 44-70% consistently — students avoid it regardless of seasoning
Brown Rice is overproduced every dinner shift — 34-38% waste, reduce batch by 25%
Meatless/vegetarian proteins (veggie burger, meatless sausage) waste 40-48% when meat alternatives are available
Butter Chicken and Teriyaki Chicken are the top performers — international students strongly prefer familiar protein-forward Asian dishes
Bakery items (muffins, pound cake, gooey bars) consistently waste 30-50% — reduce to half batch after 9AM
Barley Mushroom Pilaf and Lentil Soup are unfamiliar to most students — high waste every time served
Pizza and Shoestring Fries are near-zero waste every shift — always keep stocked
